name: openpcb-suite
description: OpenRoute (shape-aware PCB autorouter, DSN in / SES out), OpenBoard (browser PCB editor) and the openpcb agent CLI - our own implementation of the Allegro PCB Router / PCB Editor pair

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openpcb/router && npm run build -w @openpcb/editor && npm run build -w @openpcb/schematic && npm run build -w @openpcb/cli
